title: 第十章  林澈，你给我等着！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林澈站住脚，低头看着那只抓住他袖子的手，又抬头看看柳如烟那张写满慌乱的脸：

“你说救你就救你？”

“刚才还想给我下套呢，这笔账，咱们怎么算？”

柳如烟浑身都在打战，咬了咬嘴唇，声音低得像蚊子叫：

“驸马爷，此事……此事都是我无知！”

“求驸马爷救我一命...”

“无知？”

林澈嗤笑一声：

“你跑我家里来给我下套，完了一句无知便想让我救你？”

“你脑袋秀逗了吧？”

柳如烟脸上一阵红一阵白，又羞又恼又怕，偏偏一个字都反驳不出来。

林澈居高临下地看着她，伸出手，捏住她的下巴，把那张挂着泪水的俏脸抬起来：

“我想怎么样都行？”

“你确定？”

柳如烟浑身一僵，咬了咬牙，闭上眼睛，认命似的点了点头。

“只要驸马爷能救我，你让我干什么我便干什么！”

“行，那我可就不客气了。”

林澈松开手，转身坐到椅子上，翘起二郎腿，端起茶杯慢悠悠抿了一口：

“去，给我倒杯茶。”

柳如烟愣住了。

她以为自己听错了，睁大眼睛看着他。

“愣着干嘛？”

“倒茶啊。”

林澈敲了敲桌子：

“怎么，刚才说什么都行，现在倒杯茶都不乐意了？”

柳如烟连忙收敛心神，手忙脚乱地给他倒了杯茶，恭恭敬敬递过去。

林澈接过茶，又抿了一口，皱了皱眉：

“太烫了...重泡。”

柳如烟：

“……”

她深吸一口气，忍了，重新泡了一杯。

“太凉了。”

又泡了一杯。

“茶叶放多了。”

再泡一杯。

“茶叶放少了。”

柳如烟额头青筋直跳，手都在哆嗦。

堂堂秦淮河第一花魁，才子趋之若鹜的佳人！

什么时候给人端茶倒水过？

而且还是被这么来回折腾！

但她不敢发作，只能一遍遍地泡，一遍遍地换，脸上的笑容比哭还难看。

这事真不怪林澈到嘴的肉不吃，实在是不敢吃，外面还有月璇玑在虎视眈眈！

就在柳如烟快要崩溃的时候，门外忽然传来一阵急促的脚步声。

“砰！”

门被猛地推开，月璇玑一头闯了进来，张嘴就喊：

“林澈！”

“你这个无耻之徒，光天化日之下竟敢....”

后半句话，硬生生被她咽了回去。

只见林澈正襟危坐，气定神闲地品着茶，姿态优雅得像个翩翩公子。

而她安排的柳如烟，竟然主动拉着林澈的袖子，眼眶红红的！

竟是一脸不舍的模样，生怕林澈跑了似的。

月璇玑眼珠子差点没瞪出来。

这剧本不对啊！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lin Che stopped, looked down at the hand grabbing his sleeve, and then looked up at Liu Ruyan's face full of panic:

"I'll save you if you say I'll save you?"

"You were trying to set me up just now. How are we going to settle this account?"

Liu Ruyan's whole body was trembling, she bit her lip and her voice was as low as a mosquito's cry:

"Prince-in-law, this matter...this matter is all due to my ignorance!"

"Please, Prince Consort, save my life..."

"Ignorant?"

Lin Che sneered:

"You came to my house to set a trap for me, and you want me to save you after saying something ignorant?"

"Is your brain showing off?"

Liu Ruyan's face turned red and white. She was ashamed, annoyed and scared, but she couldn't refute a word.

Lin Che looked at her condescendingly, stretched out her hand, pinched her chin, and raised her pretty face with tears:

"Whatever I want is fine?"

"Are you sure?"

Liu Ruyan froze, gritted her teeth, closed her eyes, and nodded as if resigned to her fate.

"As long as the Prince Consort can save me, I will do whatever you ask me to do!"

"Okay, then I won't be polite."

Lin Che let go of her hand, turned around and sat on the chair, crossed her legs, picked up the tea cup and took a slow sip:

"Go and get me a cup of tea."

Liu Ruyan was stunned.

She thought she heard wrongly and looked at him with wide eyes.

"What are you doing standing still?"

"Pour some tea."

Lin Che knocked on the table:

"Why, just now you can say anything, but now you're not even happy to pour a cup of tea?"

Liu Ruyan quickly gathered her thoughts, hurriedly poured him a cup of tea, and handed it over respectfully.

Lin Che took the tea, took another sip, and frowned:

"Too hot...re-soak."

Liu Ruyan:

"..."

She took a deep breath, endured it, and made another cup.

"It's too cold."

Made another drink.

"There are too many tea leaves."

Make another cup.

"There are too few tea leaves."

Liu Ruyan's veins were pulsing in his forehead, and his hands were trembling.

The dignified No. 1 Oiran in the Qinhuai River, a beauty that talented people flock to!

When have you ever served someone tea and water?

And I’m still being tossed around like this!

But she didn't dare to have an attack, so she could only soak it again and again, and change it again and again, with the smile on her face uglier than crying.

I really can’t blame Lin Che for refusing to eat the meat that reached her mouth. She really didn’t dare to eat it, and there was Yue Xuanji outside who was watching eagerly!

Just when Liu Ruyan was about to collapse, there was a sudden rush of footsteps outside the door.

"Bang!"

The door was pushed open violently, and Yue Xuanji burst in, opened her mouth and shouted:

"Lin Che!"

"You shameless person, how dare you... in broad daylight..."

The second half of the sentence was swallowed hard by her.

Lin Che was seen sitting upright, sipping tea calmly and calmly, with an elegant posture like a handsome young man.

And Liu Ruyan, who she arranged, actually took the initiative to pull Lin Che's sleeve, her eyes were red!

There was a look of reluctance on her face, as if she was afraid that Lin Che would run away.

Yue Xuanji's eyes almost popped out.

This script is wrong!
